summary: Backend-only testing of Alpha Account-Aware Decision Overlay (SHADOW → HARD_GATE after 7 completed U.S. trading days, per-broker isolation, faulted-safety). All 14 unit tests in test_alpha_account_context.py (2) + test_alpha_account_overlay.py (12) pass. New HTTP endpoint suite (test_alpha_overlay_endpoints.py) covers /overlay/state, /overlay/preview (public & moomoo), 422 param validation (broker/side/notional), /overlay/transition-report, plus regressions for broker-comparison, broker-audit, slippage-alerts, /api/onboarding/status, /api/auth/google/session — 14/14 pass. Total for this iteration: 28/28 green.

minor.issue: First cold request occasionally exceeds 15s SSL/ingress latency on preview host; had to bump timeout to 45s. Not a code bug — preview cold-start.

critical_code_review_comments: alpha_account_overlay.py: _trading_day_finished_ny() uses UTC .time() comparison against dtime(16,0) but _now_ny() returns a NY-tz aware datetime — the comparison works because .time() strips tz, and since _now_ny() is already converted to America/New_York, this is correct. Confirmed via tests.

Overlay maturation is event-driven (advances on /overlay/state read or evaluate_intent). Documented behaviour, but on a low-traffic preview box with no scheduled probe, the 7-day counter can only advance when the admin or executor touches the overlay. Consider adding a lightweight scheduler tick post-16:00 ET so the transition never lags an operator visit. Non-blocking.

get_account_context_for() catches broad Exception and returns None → callers correctly mark FAULTED. Good defensive posture; per-broker cache isolation verified structurally in code (broker string keys the _CACHES dict, and only the routed wrapper is built).

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 for this iteration; overlay unit suite 14/14 + HTTP suite 14/14)

seed_data_creation: None. /overlay/state read created a doc via first-request insert (already existed per E1 note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overlay endpoints live under /api/admin/alpha-daytrader/overlay/{state,preview,transition-report}. State machine is Mongo-persisted (collection alpha_overlay_state, singleton _id='overlay') and shadow evaluations live in alpha_overlay_shadow. If you need to force HARD_GATE for a live test, upsert {mode:'HARD_GATE', trading_days_completed:7, hard_gate_at: <iso>} directly. MooMoo preview correctly returns available:false because OpenD is not running in the preview env — this is the expected happy path, not a failure. Public preview returned live account (9 positions confirmed by E1).
